3look_606846.name: 3look
3look_606846.description:
3look is an AI-based application that allows users to create and publish content for social networks, mainly memes and GIF images, with the ability to post directly on platforms like X (formerly Twitter) for results-based rewards.

It serves as a content creation studio where users generate branded or custom content using AI tools for rapid idea generation, face swapping to NFT or crypto assets, and publishing, while the AI scoring system transparently evaluates impact, distributing revenue without requiring constant interaction.

Designed as a SocialFi project on ApeChain within the ApeCoin ecosystem, it transforms user-created content into blockchain-rewarded assets, with partnerships expanding to networks like Ice Open Network for decentralized social layers.

activities.title: Public Alpha Waitlist
activities.description:
3look announced Public Alpha! We can connect our X account and wait for access to the platform. The higher your score, the faster your application will be approved.

1. Go to the website and connect your X account
2. Enter your email
3. Invite friends to boost your score

activities.title: First Campaign: The Loop Season 1
activities.description:
3look announced the launch of the first campaign The Loop Season 1. If you have access to the public alpha, you can share in a reward pool of 30,000,000 3look points, which will be used for future rewards and benefits.

1. Go to the website, enter your email and connect your X
2. Open the "Campaigns" tab and start completing tasks

42_prev_alkimiya_281002.name: 42 (prev. Alkimiya)
42_prev_alkimiya_281002.description: 42 is a protocol designed for creating, trading, and settling synthetic resources of the blockchain space through peer-to-peer smart contracts. Public blockchains have limited capabilities for conducting transactions, leading to competition and fee fluctuations. 42 solves this by converting key blockchain resources, such as average transaction fees, into tradeable assets, enabling better pricing and resource allocation. This system benefits various users: miners can secure future income by selling transaction fees, service providers like wallets and exchanges can hedge against fee volatility by purchasing them, and builders can compensate for high mining costs.

activities.title: Waitlist
activities.description:
Since the last activity was published, Alkimiya has rebranded and is now called 42. The project positions itself as a prediction-market platform. We can enter a wallet address and X username to get early access to 42.

1. Go to the website, enter any code, then wallet address and X username
2. Periodically check if you've received access to the platform by clicking Verify my Beta entry
3. You can get faster access to the platform by participating in events on Discord

action_model_229125.name: Action Model
action_model_229125.description:
ActionModel is developing a community-owned Large Action Model (LAM) — an AI system designed to perform real digital tasks on computers by interacting with graphical user interfaces (GUIs), rather than just generating text like traditional Large Language Models (LLMs). It tracks screen states, makes decisions about actions using its own action tree built based on user contributions, executes these actions, and loops until the task is completed. This enables autonomous workflow automation without using APIs.

The project counters centralized AI development by major tech companies through community contribution: users install a browser extension for passive or active learning and create/sell reusable workflows on a marketplace where execution earns creators ongoing rewards.

$LAM is the native token that powers actions, rewards learning and contributions, provides governance, and represents ownership share in the AI system.

activities.title: Points Farming
activities.description:
Action Model announced the launch of the extension and platform for training AI agents. You can participate in training by simply installing the browser extension and going about your usual internet activities. On the Action Model platform, in the ActionFI section, you can complete tasks on various platforms and earn points.

1. Go to the website and register with your email
2. Open the "Get Started" tab, complete available tasks and install the extension
3. Go to the "Quests" tab and complete available tasks
4. In the "ActionFi" tab, complete tasks for points with multiplier

activities.title: TaskOn
activities.description:
Campaigns with quests for training and content creation are available on the TaskOn platform. By completing quests, you earn LAM points that reflect your contribution to the project's development and can later be converted to tokens or affect your allocation in the airdrop distribution.

1. Go to the website and connect your wallet. Start completing quests
